card.name: Inside the word interleukin
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, right before a hyphen and a number such as -1 or -2. It also fires weakly on the middle of rare words like anecdotally, enlistment and itinerant.

modes.label: Interleukin before number
modes.description: The ending "in" of interleukin just before -1 or -2 in drug names and warnings.

modes.label: Middle of rare words
modes.description: Partway through uncommon general words that are split into pieces.
